speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; these symptoms require a careful evaluation to determine the underlying cause. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any fevers or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant amount of weight loss in a short time. Given your age and these systemic symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as blood in your stool or a persistent change in stool caliber?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple sclerosis is highly unlikely given your age (71) and the severe unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg; these symptoms are more concerning for a malignancy such as lymphoma or gastrointestinal cancer. I need to clarify if you have had any night sweats or abdominal pain, and I will order a CT Chest and Abdomen/Pelvis to investigate.
